note: Snapshot of the setup interview's question id -> env keys, parsed from vizra-core internal/setup/questions.go at source_commit (named key lists such as `Keys: topoKeys` are resolved). Refresh: `python3 -I scripts/snapshot-setup-keys.py <vizra-core checkout>` and paste source_commit + questions + compose_keys in one edit. `scripts/snapshot-setup-keys.py --check <vizra-core checkout>` (validate lane) fails unless source_commit is an ancestor of vizra-core origin/main and the parse at that commit equals this file. Checked by scripts/check-config-coverage.py rules setup-key-untemplated and template-key-unasked.

compose_keys.COMPOSE_FILE: read by Docker Compose itself from the --env-file (vizra-core internal/setup/engine.go:79-80); computed from the postgres/redis/analytics/ipfs topology answers and checked against them by `vizra setup --check` (engine.go:136), so a hand-editable template line would only invite a mismatch
compose_keys.COMPOSE_PROFILES: read by Docker Compose itself from the --env-file (vizra-core internal/setup/engine.go:79-80); computed from the topology answers together with COMPOSE_FILE, same reason

compose_keys_note: Keys `vizra setup` writes that Docker Compose reads, not a container. Must equal vizra-core setup.ComposeKeys at source_commit. They count as handled for setup-key-untemplated and must NOT appear in env/production.env.example.

setup_reads.VIZRA_TLS_MODE: internal/setup/edge.go RenderEdge (which edge file is rendered; external = no edge profile)

setup_reads_note: Keys no compose file interpolates but `vizra setup` itself reads at the commit above. They count as consumed for template-key-unused. Do not add a key here without a file:function in vizra-core that reads it.
unread_keys_note: Keys the interview writes that nothing reads (no compose interpolation, no core registry key, no setup code path); they are deliberately NOT in the template. Empty at source_commit: merged core has no storage/S3, SMTP, registration or import question. setup-key-untemplated fails on a written key that is in none of the template, compose_keys or this list.
